## Causes

Attribution: a team-game counts under a cause when a combination with the fewest causes
that includes it makes the team-game match; "alone" when the cause by itself does, and
"another combination also matches" when a different combination of the same size does too.
Effect: the cause's adjustment applied alone to every team-game, adjusted value minus
unadjusted, on the side it adjusts: this repository's, or the other's for an undone repair.

### Pre-2006 scrambles counted as dropbacks (`scramble_dropbacks`)

- There: dropback_expr counts a run play flagged qb_scramble as a dropback, so it is also a scrimmage snap; nflverse leaves qb_dropback at 0 on most scrambles before 2006.
- Here: A dropback and a scrimmage snap need qb_dropback, rush, qb_kneel or qb_spike; a pre-2006 scramble coded with none of them is in no team-game count here.
- Adjustment: Set qb_dropback to 1 on run plays flagged qb_scramble, then re-aggregate. This repository's cache leaves qb_scramble out, so the flag comes from the snapshot of the play-by-play the other repository read, attached row by row after the snapshot is checked equal to the cache.
- Team-games it explains (alone or with another cause): 2527; games: 1264; seasons: 1999-2005.
